ctx.x: Sometimes we traveled in, if it was close, in Herbie’s car. I mean, not the whole band but some of the guys. The other guys have cars so we drove up to…where is that club behind the bar? Buffalo! We drove up to Buffalo, by the time we got to Albany—well, New York was, you could see the ground. By the time we got to Albany, the snow was so high we had to stop. We missed the first night, could not get to Buffalo. I remember that. Herbie’s car broke down and he got it fixed at some place off the highway, off the…
